Name: Ilucie's Skull Replacement
Author: IlucieYt
Description:
Tired of those scary skulls in the mines that seem to come straight from hell?
Allow me to introduce the ANGRY CHICKENS. Their tiny little angry faces will sure haunt you as well, but... come on they are only chickens!

I replaced the Haunted Skull and the dangerous Haunted Skull with an angry red chicken and an angry void chicken after I learned that some people find them scary.

I hope you like it!

Manifest.Name: Ilucie's Skull Monster replacement
Manifest.Description: Replaces the scary skulls with angry chickens.
